zh.title: NavoPath Beta · 任务与日程工作台
zh.description: 在同一页挑任务、排时间、改日程。通过插件市场按需添加课表、快速收集等功能。
zh.share: 左边选任务，右边排时间。打开 NavoPath Beta，免登录试排一个任务。

en.title: NavoPath Beta · Tasks and timeline
en.description: Pick tasks, schedule them, and adjust your day on one page. Add tools like Class Timetable and Quick Capture from the plugin market.
en.share: Pick a task on the left and schedule it on the right. Try NavoPath Beta without signing in.
